description:
* Develop a strong understanding of warehouse operations, logistics processes, and supply chain workflows.
* Provide day-to-day IT support for Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and related SCM applications.
* Regularly visit warehouse sites to monitor system performance, understand operational challenges, and support business users.
* Ensure stable operation of IT systems supporting inbound, outbound, inventory management, and warehouse activities.
* Collaborate with warehouse and logistics teams to identify operational improvement opportunities.
* Act as the primary IT contact for warehouse and SCM-related incidents.
* Investigate system issues and coordinate recovery actions with business users, vendors, and Global IT teams.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Monitor incident trends and proactively recommend preventive measures to improve system stability.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately while ensuring timely communication with stakeholders.
requirements_text:
* Candidates with 5+ years of experience in SCM systems, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), ERP, Logistics, Supply Chain, or related areas are highly preferred. Strong understanding of warehouse operations and logistics processes is required.
* Experience supporting or implementing supply chain transformation projects, WMS, logistics platforms, warehouse automation, system rollout, incident management, and root cause analysis is strongly preferred.
